question: What is the first name, country code, and birth date of the player with the most winner rank points across all matches?
reference_sql: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.country_code ,  T1.birth_date FROM players AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.winner_id ORDER BY T2.winner_rank_points DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.first_name, p.country_code, p.birth_date
FROM players p
JOIN (
    SELECT winner_id, SUM(winner_rank_points) AS total_points
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY winner_id
    ORDER BY total_points DESC
    LIMIT 1
) wp ON p.player_id = wp.winner_id
